name: Generic Profile: Product selection
abstract: Selects, from a catalogue, the products of a collection whose footprint intersects an area of interest and whose acquisition time falls within a time interval. An area of interest, a time interval and a collection in, the selected products out.

sources.title: OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 Interface Standard Corrigendum 2, §7.5.2 Generic Process Profile
